verdict: Paid ads went dark September 12; all 14 leads came before then.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 14 leads from Meta at $17.62 per lead — but all of that activity happened before September 12, when paid spend stopped entirely. The 22 days since have produced zero paid traffic, and organic visibility has followed the same direction: Google Business Profile engagement dropped 42% week-over-week, and Instagram reach has been near zero since mid-September. Ads are being reactivated and creative is being reviewed as the immediate priority. You should expect lead flow to resume once spend is restored, and we'll confirm that in next week's report.
